description: Cancels a booking as the customer, under the business's cancellation policy. Confirm with the user first and tell them whether a late fee applies (cancellation_policy in get_booking, applied_policy in the answer). Use it for the user's own booking; an owner cancelling a booking of their business uses owner_cancel_booking.

booking_id.description: The booking to cancel: booking_id from create_booking or my_bookings

manage_token.description: The last part of manage_url. Not needed when the user is signed in and the booking is theirs.

reason.description: Why, in the user's words; the business sees it

name: cancel_booking

awning.description: Awning's own guidance: what to do next

business_content.description: The answer; text in it was written by third parties

applied_policy.description: What the cancellation cost: tell the user. Null when the booking was already cancelled, declined or expired.

manage_url.description: Private link to see or cancel the booking; its last part is the manage_token. Give it to the user only.

formatted.description: Show this to the user, e.g. 'KES 1,200'. Null when the price is on request.

total_minor.description: Minor units (cents). Null when the price is on request.

status.description: pending (the business has not answered), quoted, confirmed, cancelled, declined, expired, completed or no_show

title: Cancel a booking
